verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal/document automation product for startups; the evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out, or privacy controls of that kind. This is a plausible axis for a SaaS product, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na. Missing for 10: any privacy policy or docs referencing telemetry/usage data collection, an opt-out mechanism, or settings controlling analytics tracking.
